title: LLCBookKeepingPrivate bookkeeping-to-tax exchange v1
description: Sole canonical bookkeeping-to-tax exchange contract. Carries already computed cash-basis book totals copied exactly from an existing LLCBookKeepingPrivate cash-basis report. Book figures only: this record is not a tax return, tax classification, deductibility determination, tax-basis determination, tax liability estimate, or claim of compatibility with any tax-return software. No synchronization or import is implemented. Consumers must identify the exact revision of this file they rely on.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Any value other than 1 must be rejected.

basis.description: Accounting basis of the copied report.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of all cent amounts.

reference.description: Producer-supplied reference identifying the source cash-basis report.

period.description: Inclusive report period. fromDate must be on or before throughDate; both must be real calendar dates.

reviewStatus.description: These book totals have not been reviewed by a CPA or tax preparer.

totals.description: Cash-basis book totals in integer cents, copied exactly from the source report without recomputation, allocation, or tax classification.

limitations.description: Fixed limitation statements. Must equal this exact ordered list.
const: Book figures only, copied from a cash-basis bookkeeping report.
Not a tax return, tax classification, deductibility determination, tax-basis determination, or tax liability estimate.
Not reviewed by a CPA or tax preparer.
No synchronization or import is implemented; sharing this record is an explicit user action.

nonEmptyText.description: Trimmed text without control characters, 1 to 200 characters.

calendarDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD real calendar date (for example 2026-02-29 is invalid).

cents.description: Signed decimal integer string of cents with no leading zeros and no negative zero. Arbitrary magnitude; never a JSON number.
